description: break-word breaks a word only when it would overflow.

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 12.41% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Without the feature the same fixture measures 41.20% and the box is 66.0px off, so it fails.
